note: Fixed status lines in the five languages, taken word for word from the frontend's message files (Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo are the natively reviewed wording). They carry no amount or name. Rendered and shipped with the other clips; the call_* lines are the phone-approval prompts.

en.paid: Paid. The money has left your account.
en.expired: This request expired. Nothing was sent.
en.processing: Processing. Don't hand over goods yet.
en.call_intro: This is Zolo. Someone has asked for a payment from your account.
en.call_menu: To approve, press 1. To decline, press 2. To hear it again, press 9.
en.call_privacy: Make sure no one can hear you.
en.call_pin: Enter your four digit Zolo PIN now.
en.call_wrong_pin: That PIN was wrong. Nothing was sent. Goodbye.
en.call_locked: Phone approval is locked for now. Nothing was sent. Goodbye.
en.call_changed: This payment changed. Nothing was sent. Goodbye.
en.call_expired: This request expired. Nothing was sent. Goodbye.
en.call_limit: This payment is over the phone limit. Nothing was sent. Goodbye.
en.call_none: No payment was approved. Nothing was sent. Goodbye.

pcm.declined: You don decline. We no send anything.
pcm.expired: This request don expire. We no send anything.

pcm.call_intro: Na Zolo dey call. Person don ask for payment from your account.

yo.paid: A ti san án. Owó náà ti kúrò nínú àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ.
yo.declined: O kọ̀. A kò fi nǹkan kankan ránṣẹ́.
yo.expired: Ìbéèrè yìí ti parí. A kò fi nǹkan kankan ránṣẹ́.
yo.processing: À ń ṣe é lọ́wọ́. Má ṣe fún ẹnikẹ́ni ní ẹrù rẹ̀ sibẹ̀.
yo.call_intro: Zolo ni èyí. Ẹnìkan ti béèrè fún owó láti inú àkọọ́lẹ̀ rẹ.
yo.call_menu: Láti fọwọ́ sí i, tẹ ọ̀kan. Láti kọ̀, tẹ méjì. Láti gbọ́ ọ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i, tẹ mẹ́sàn-án.
yo.call_privacy: Rí i dájú pé ẹnikẹ́ni kò gbọ́ ọ.
yo.call_pin: Tẹ nọ́ńbà ìdánimọ̀ Zolo oní-nọ́ńbà mẹ́rin rẹ báyìí.
yo.call_wrong_pin: Nọ́ńbà ìdánimọ̀ yẹn kò tọ́. A kò fi nǹkankan ránṣẹ́. O dìgbà.
yo.call_locked: A ti ti ìfọwọ́sí lórí fóònù fún ìgbà díẹ̀. A kò fi nǹkankan ránṣẹ́. O dìgbà.
yo.call_approved: A ti fọwọ́ sí i. O dìgbà.
yo.call_declined: O ti kọ̀. A kò fi nǹkankan ránṣẹ́. O dìgbà.
yo.call_changed: Ìsanwó yìí ti yípadà. A kò fi nǹkankan ránṣẹ́. O dìgbà.
yo.call_expired: Ìbéèrè yìí ti parí àkókò. A kò fi nǹkankan ránṣẹ́. O dìgbà.
yo.call_limit: Ìsanwó yìí ju ààlà fóònù lọ. A kò fi nǹkankan ránṣẹ́. O dìgbà.
yo.call_none: A kò fọwọ́ sí ìsanwó kankan. A kò fi nǹkankan ránṣẹ́. O dìgbà.

ha.paid: An biya. Kuɗin ya fita daga asusunka.
ha.declined: Ka ƙi. Ba a aika komai ba.
ha.expired: Wannan buƙata ta ƙare. Ba a aika komai ba.
ha.processing: Ana aiwatarwa. Kada ka ba da kayan tukuna.

ig.paid: Akwụọla ụgwọ. Ego ahụ esila n'akaụntụ gị pụọ.
ig.declined: Ị jụrụ. Anyị zigaghị ihe ọ bụla.
ig.expired: Arịrịọ a agwụla. Anyị zigaghị ihe ọ bụla.
ig.processing: Anyị na-arụ ọrụ na ya. Ejila ngwaahịa nye onye ọ bụla ugbu a.
